page.layout: One page with a single table of six numerical columns, plus a seventh column at the right for the ferial (weekday) letters. Running head centred at top, page number top right. A single letter "T" centred below the last row.

main_text.l: Anniante ord. | Aur. Iul. num. | Anni O-lympiad. | An. Vrb. cond. | Literæ domin. | Nabona-fari. | Feriæ.

page.notes: Reference marks g, h and i stand in the Nabonassar column at rows 225, 246 and 257, and * at 227; they are printed without a matching note on this page. The Feriæ entries for 256–258 are faint and partly rubbed; 256 "7", 257 "1" and 258 "2" are read with some doubt. The gap in the left columns (between 477 and 476) is an unnumbered blank row, aligned with the row marked * 227. Dashes are leader lines and are not transcribed. The letter T at the foot is a printed signature mark. The top-right "289" is the page number. The "ANNORVM." head is the running title.
